description.value:
You reshape your body with tech, choosing one of three effects that lasts for the power's duration; as an action, you can later switch to a different option.

Aquatic Adaptation lets you breathe underwater and grants a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

Change Appearance lets you alter your height, build, features, voice, and coloration, including appearing as a member of another species of similar size and basic shape (an organic species can't appear as a droid, or vice versa) and speaking a language you know but couldn't otherwise voice, though your statistics remain unchanged. You may reshape your appearance again at will as an action for the duration.

Natural Weapons grows claws, fangs, or a similar natural weapon, raising your unarmed strike damage die by one step (1 to d4, d4 to d6, or d6 to d8); your unarmed strikes count as enhanced and gain a +1 bonus to their attack and damage rolls.
